en.name: Delirium Observation Screening (DOS) Scale
en.shortDescription: Nursing observation-based screening instrument for early recognition of delirium, completed each shift
en.longDescription: ## Definition & Clinical Context The DOS (Delirium Observation Screening Scale) is a nursing observation-based screening instrument for early recognition of delirium based on DSM-IV criteria [1]. The instrument comprises 13 items covering behaviours such as: - dozing off during conversation - distractibility and inattention - disorientation in time or place - slow response to instructions - restlessness or picking behaviour - hallucinations Each item is scored 0 (normal) or 1 (abnormal behaviour observed). The total score ranges from 0 to 13. A score ≥ 3 suggests delirium. The scale is completed once per nursing shift (up to three times per 24 hours). ## Included Concepts This concept set contains a single custom concept, as no equivalent exists in standard terminologies (SNOMED, LOINC). ## References [1] Schuurmans MJ, Shortridge-Baggett LM, Duursma SA. The Delirium Observation Screening Scale: a screening instrument for delirium. *Res Theory Nurs Pract*. 2003;17(1):31-50. PMID: 12751884

fr.name: Delirium Observation Screening (DOS) Scale
fr.shortDescription: Outil de dépistage du delirium par l'observation infirmière, complété à chaque vacation pour une détection précoce
fr.longDescription: ## Définition et contexte clinique Le DOS (Delirium Observation Screening Scale) est un instrument de dépistage du délirium basé sur l'observation infirmière, fondé sur les critères du DSM-IV [1]. L'instrument comprend 13 items couvrant des comportements tels que : - assoupissement pendant la conversation - distractibilité et inattention - désorientation dans le temps ou l'espace - lenteur de réponse aux instructions - agitation ou comportement de préhension - hallucinations Chaque item est coté 0 (normal) ou 1 (comportement anormal observé). Le score total varie de 0 à 13. Un score ≥ 3 suggère un délirium. L'échelle est complétée une fois par poste infirmier (jusqu'à trois fois par 24 heures). ## Concepts inclus Ce concept set contient un seul concept custom, aucun équivalent n'existant dans les terminologies standard (SNOMED, LOINC). ## Références [1] Schuurmans MJ, Shortridge-Baggett LM, Duursma SA. The Delirium Observation Screening Scale: a screening instrument for delirium. *Res Theory Nurs Pract*. 2003;17(1):31-50. PMID: 12751884

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Approved.** Used in QI07 (pain/sedation/delirium assessment). No standard OMOP concept exists for DOS; the INDICATE custom concept (>= 2,100,000,000, [issue #3](https://github.com/indicate-eu/data-dictionary/issues/3)) is acceptable as a transitional solution.

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI07 (Pain, sedation, delirium).
- CQL: all 1 concept(s) of the set are referenced in [`IndicateQi07PainSedationDelir.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi07PainSedationDelir.cql?plain=1) ([2100000004](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi07PainSedationDelir.cql?plain=1#L48); each ID links to its code definition).

## Suggestions
- None.
